answer: Each participant locks 25 POA for twelve epochs and must complete five distinct tasks, each reviewed by three randomly assigned reviewers with no shared funder or review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; proven collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays public: a quartz shell of hollow history cannot fake tenure, a mesa of graded reputation tiers gates premium work, and a meadow of independent reviewers proves real verification. Every extra sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, so cloning costs more than it returns.
